manual.summary: Scroll bar should appear only if required.
Check enough space is applied between field labels, columns, rows and errors.
All text should be properly aligned.
Check the site is responsive at 767px, 768px, 1080px and 1920px.
manual.tools: Web Developer toolbar: Resize, View Responsive Layouts

manual.summary: Font should be consistent throughout the site.
Display appropriate server-side and client-side validation for form fields.
Check for broken links, missing images, CSS, Flash, RSS, script errors, expired domains and server configuration issues.
Test all mandatory fields validate correctly based on user input.
Test accented letters are displayed correctly in Page Editor and the front end.
manual.sourceNotes: The source checklist contains examples covering common European accented characters.

manual.summary: Test no mandatory error message is present for optional fields.
Test leap years are validated correctly and do not cause errors.
Test negative input values for each field.
Test the maximum length of every field to ensure data is not truncated.
Check a confirmation message is displayed for update and delete operations.
Test all input fields for special characters.
Test the sorting and filtering functionality.
Test no errors are present in the browser console.
Test the functionality of buttons, including enabled, disabled and hidden states.
Test that failed functionality redirects the user to the custom error page (404).
Test all uploaded documents open correctly in a new window, new tab or intended destination.
Test the user is able to download files.
Test email functionality, such as feedback and order confirmation.
Validate that blank form submissions are not allowed and at least one field is required.
Test external page links open in a new tab or window.
Check Create, Edit, Delete and Publish for a new component.
Verify data retrieval delivers the correct data, such as Search and News sections.
Ensure search functions correctly and results are accurate and helpful to the customer.
Test page rendering at different screen resolutions and rotations.
manual.tools: Web Developer toolbar: Resize, View Responsive Layouts
manual.sourceNotes: Chrome developer tools can also be used to switch between representative devices.

manual.summary: Test that the CSS and HTML used are compatible with the appropriate browser and device versions.
manual.tools: Edge, Chrome, Firefox, Safari, iPhone and Android

manual.summary: Apply inputs that force all error messages to occur.
Repeatedly attempt to submit a form by continually clicking the submit action.
Force different outputs to be generated for each input.
Attempt to fill the file system to its capacity.
Attempt to submit blank forms repeatedly.
Attempt to view an invalid page URL within the site.
Alter strings within the webpages where applicable and ensure an appropriate message is displayed.
Run Google PageSpeed to identify performance improvements.
Run Lighthouse Accessibility to identify accessibility improvements.

release.summary: All designs are signed off.
Acceptance criteria are locked down.
All code changes are complete and peer reviewed for each user story delivered.
The test environment is fully configured to update customer websites dynamically.
Test cases are documented and ready for execution.
Unit testing and VQA are complete before changes are pushed to development.
Modified requirements are updated in acceptance criteria rather than Jira comments or designs.
New requirements treated as changes are addressed in a new user story.
If designs change, updated designs are recorded in Jira with the exact layouts and styles used for testing.
All acceptance criteria have been verified.
All targeted and integrated testing is completed.
Any bugs found are raised in Jira, assigned to the appropriate developer and linked to the parent story.
Bug fixes are deployed and validated as resolved.
The automated test suite is maintained and updated for additional requirements.

Test below 767px.
